scope: Exploratory labeled few-shot adaptation on repeatedly exposed original30, same-parent temporal blocks; NOT zero-shot, independent confirmation, cross-day, Cyton or deployment evidence
preprocessing: Unchanged original fixed8 8-30Hz500sample cache; no new filter/window/channel search
source: Original source26-fit/3-source-validation EEGNet checkpoint, scaler, all learned weights and BN buffers frozen; NOT prior BN candidate
fit: StandardScaler on own80 frozen240 features only; ridge residual y-p_source, objective mean squared error + alpha*||w||^2, unpenalized intercept; dual solve80x80
selection: 13 validation candidates per branch: identity first then strength ascending, alpha descending; max BA on own40, earliest tie; no better than source => identity
probability_definition: Stable softmax class1 from frozen logits, NOT externally calibrated confidence; p_new=clip(p_source+strength*clip(residual,-cap,cap),0,1); free branch omits inner cap
prediction: Class1 if score>0.5, otherwise class0; original old logits argmax and head margin>0 preserved
new_fit_budget: 90 cases x4 ridge solves=360 shared solutions; two branches share solutions and each select among13 configs; 180 selected states frozen before any new later forward
primary_metric: Mean30-person BA, first mean seeds42/43/44 per person; all four methods same2480 unique later trials
hypothesis: Preserving source readout and bounding personal residual can outperform source under fixed80/40 labeled budget; failure of declared primary gate falsifies practical benefit for this recipe, not all adaptation
budget_limitation: Old LDA head fit80 without validation selection; residual uses80 fit plus40 validation labels and13 validation options per branch, disclosed, not identical tuning budget or label access to zero-shot source
bad_trial_policy: All6080 identities/515 flags retained, test2480/198 flags retained, no quality or score-based removal
